name: Warsong Outrider Update
summary: Along Ashenvale’s eastern border, a Warsong Outrider prepares the Warsong Outrider Update. Stationed there, the outrider records frontline intelligence for Horde couriers to carry. The reports help secure the crossing toward Azshara and strengthen the orcish foothold against night elf resistance.

sections.title: Frontier Intelligence
sections.body:
Beyond Splintertree Post, the eastern road crosses Ashenvale’s volatile borderlands toward the ancient ruins of Azshara. Mounted orcish vanguards patrol this frontier and record tactical sightings, patrol movements, and resource evaluations.

They send their field notes to Kadrak at the northern watchtower, which guards the Barrens border. The reports give Horde commanders a clear view of enemy troop concentrations and territorial threats beneath the forest canopy.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this update?
faq.answer: The update reports night elf activity and conditions along the eastern Ashenvale road toward Azshara. Kadrak uses the intelligence to coordinate Horde troop deployments and strengthen defenses along the Barrens’ northern border.

faq.q: Who carries and delivers this dispatch?
aliases: where does outrider update come from
faq.answer: A Warsong Outrider patrolling the highway between Splintertree Post and the border of Azshara carries the dispatch. The outrider delivers it to Kadrak and receives fresh strategic orders.

faq.q: Where does this report need to go?
aliases: where do i take outrider update
faq.answer: Bring the update directly to Kadrak at the northern watchtower. The tower guards the Barrens border and the southern entrance to Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why are the Warsong so invested in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The Warsong Clan logs Ashenvale’s ancient forests for lumber and construction materials needed in Orgrimmar. Their gathering brings them into conflict with the defending night elves and Silverwing Sentinels.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you depend on frontline reports to protect supply routes between the Barrens and Ashenvale. Those routes carry lumber needed to expand Orgrimmar.
As an orc, you rely on vigilant scouts and swift couriers to uphold Warsong honor and hold territory against the night elf sentinels disputing your clan’s forestry claims.
